thread:
Sarah M: Heads-up — planning a co-hosted track with NovaCloud + EdgeLabs for May 14. Goal: localized slides, remote demo pods, and unified lead capture. Anyone opposed to recording with subtitles?
Ankur P: Sounds great. Which timezones are we targeting? US primary or multi-region stream? :earth_americas:
Sarah M: Primary US/EMEA live; we'll record and publish APAC-friendly re-run. Need translated decks from partners. Mei, can you own translation coordination?
Mei L: I can. Need final decks by May 1 to do translations and captions. Where should partners drop source slides?
Alex (Partnerships): Put in /shared/partner-assets. I'll collect logos and speaker bios. Note: EdgeLabs wants to ship a small hardware demo image — they need a test image deployed to remote pods.
Jordan K: EdgeLabs HW build finishes Apr 28. We can ship 6 venue kits + 4 remote host kits. Will need customs paperwork for EU leg.
Chris R: Swag numbers: 500 stickers, 120 shirts (S-XL), 60 enamel pins. Budget ok? :moneybag:
Sarah M: Budget approved. Action: ship shirts directly to partner leads, pins to booth inventory.
Alex (Partnerships): Proposed run-of-show speaker split: 12:30-12:50 Redwood product + live demo; 12:50-13:10 NovaCloud platform demo; 13:10-13:25 EdgeLabs HW micro-demo; 13:25-13:40 panel + Q&A. Thoughts?
Mei L: Can we do a 48h dry-run? Propose May 12, 10:00 PDT for full audiovisual + captions check.
Jordan K: May 12 works. I'll reserve remote demo pods and validate network egress rules.
Sarah M: Runbook snippet for remote demos (put in runbook doc):
```
Remote-demo checklist:
- image: rwinf/mesa-demo:prod-3.2
- netcheck: curl https://health.redwood.ai/ping
- user: demo@redwood (temp creds via secrets manager)
- fallback: docker run rwinf/local-fallback:1.0
- logging: push logs to /var/log/remote-demo and tag with kit-serial
```
Chris R: Shipping manifest note: include kit serial numbers and a simple label 'RW-PARTNER-DEMO-<serial>'. Please add customs HS codes for hardware.
Alex (Partnerships): Partners requested a 2-slide 'integrator checklist' they can reuse. Can someone draft it? Simple: prerequisites + contact points.
Mei L: I'll draft the 2 slides and include localized bullet copies. Need initial copy by Apr 25.
Sarah M: Partner legal: Alex please confirm partners sign broadcast consent by Apr 30. Also need logo usage perms.
Alex (Partnerships): On it. I'll send the consent template and collect signed confirmations.
Chris R: Small sample kit request: 30 USB keys with README + sticker pack for booth handouts. Jordan, can you pack and label?
Jordan K: Yes — packing list and addresses by May 5. Will confirm weight for courier quotes.
Ankur P: For accessibility + compliance — we'll add live captions and upload VTT for each language. Vendor recs: Rev.com for ENG, partners can provide local language captions. Also will wire captions into Zoom stream.
events-bot: Reminder: create Zoom webinar + collect CC list. Auto-created recording folder: /events/may14/recordings
Sarah M: Lead capture: QR to short form + Segment integration for GDPR opt-in. Ankur will implement Pixel/Segment mapping.
Ankur P: Yep — will wire QR to Segment and enable opt-in checkbox. Also add UTM params for partner attribution.
Sarah M: Final logistics: dry-run May 12 10:00 PDT, final assets deadline May 1, shipping cutoff May 5. Owners: Mei = translations/slides, Jordan = hardware/logistics, Chris = swag/manifest, Alex = partner liaison/legal, Sarah = run-of-show.
Chris R: Noted. Will circulate final swag packing list this week.
Alex (Partnerships): I'll also confirm speaker time allocations with partners and ping for rehearsal availabilities.
Mei L: Draft for integrator slides will be in /shared/partner-assets/drafts by Apr 22 for early review.
Sarah M: Great — next sync Tue 4/29 9:00am PT. Please add agenda items if needed. :thumbsup:
